plans.name: Click 2 Protect Life
plans.tagline: Online pure term plan with a Life option, a Life & Critical Illness option and an Income Plus option
plans.sum_assured_note: No upper limit, subject to underwriting. The Life & CI option starts at ₹20 L.
death_benefit_options: Life cover plus monthly income (Income Plus)
riders: Protect Plus Rider (accidental death, disability, cancer)
Income Benefit on Accidental Disability Rider
Waiver of Premium on Critical Illness (in-plan option)
key_features: Special rates for women and non-tobacco users
Death benefit is the higher of sum assured and 105% of premiums paid
exclusions: Suicide within 12 months of start or revival: nominee gets at least 80% of premiums paid or the surrender value, whichever is higher
notes: The plan page and the key feature document disagree on maximum entry age (65 vs 60). The 60 appears to be the point-of-sale variant.
HDFC also sells Click 2 Protect Supreme Plus, which we have not covered.

plans.name: iProtect Smart Plus
plans.tagline: Online term plan with four payout options and optional accident cover
plans.sum_assured_note: Limits not confirmed. Optional accidental death benefit is available.
key_features: Cover available up to age 99
Terminal illness benefit on all options
Premium break option
Instant payout on claim registration
exclusions: No death benefit if death occurs within 90 days of the start of risk for policies sold through point of sale

sample_premium.note: ICICI's published sample: healthy non-smoking salaried male, regular pay, lump sum payout, first year, before tax

notes: The brochure could not be read, so the eligibility limits above are unconfirmed.
The older iProtect Smart appears to have been replaced by iProtect Smart Plus on the insurer's site.

plans.name: Smart Term Plan Plus
plans.tagline: Term plan with eight variants, including return of premium, income protection and whole life
plans.sum_assured_note: No upper limit, subject to underwriting. Whole life goes to age 100. Some variants have lower entry age limits (50 or 44).
key_features: Lower premium rates for non-smokers
Terminal illness benefit
Option to top up cover
exclusions: Suicide within 12 months of start or revival: higher of surrender value or premiums paid

plans.name: Sampoorna Raksha Promise
plans.tagline: Tata AIA's current protection plan, with four options including return of premium
plans.sum_assured_note: No upper limit, subject to underwriting. The Plus option needs at least a 10-year term. Point-of-sale cases have lower age limits.
death_benefit_options: Life Promise Plus (returns premiums at maturity)
key_features: Premium break option
Cover can be increased at life stages
Whole life cover available
exclusions: Suicide within 12 months of start or revival: at least 80% of premiums paid or the surrender value, whichever is higher
notes: The brochure's policy-term table was hard to read, so the minimum term is approximate.
The page URL still says 'supreme' but now shows Sampoorna Raksha Promise.

plans.name: Digi Term (Plan 876)
plans.tagline: LIC's online-only term plan with level or increasing cover
plans.sum_assured_note: ₹50 L to ₹5 Cr. Above that, case by case.
death_benefit_options: Payout in instalments over 5, 10 or 15 years (optional)
key_features: Separate smoker and non-smoker rates
Special rates for women
Online only
exclusions: Suicide within 12 months of start or revival: nominee gets 80% of premiums paid
notes: No riders are offered with this plan.
LIC also sells New Tech-Term, which we have not covered. Maximum entry age is 45, so many people over 45 cannot buy this plan.

plans.name: Smart Shield Plus
plans.tagline: Term plan with level, increasing and future-proofing cover and an optional spouse benefit
plans.sum_assured_note: No upper limit, subject to underwriting. Maximum entry age is 60 for regular pay. Whole life goes to age 100.
death_benefit_options: Level cover with future proofing (increases at life events)
riders: Accident Benefit Rider (accidental death, or accidental partial permanent disability)
key_features: Cover can rise at marriage or childbirth
Only an accident rider is offered; no critical illness rider
exclusions: Suicide within 12 months of start or revival: nominee gets 80% of premiums paid or the unexpired risk premium value, whichever is higher
notes: The older eShield Next now redirects to this plan.
Smoker rates are inferred from the brochure's illustration tables.

plans.name: eTouch II
plans.tagline: Term plan with Life Shield, Life Shield Plus and return-of-premium variants
plans.sum_assured_note: No upper limit, subject to underwriting. Maximum entry age is 55 for Pay-till-60. Return of premium variant matures by 85.
premium_payment_options: Limited pay (5 to 20 years, or pay till 60)
riders: Accidental Permanent Total/Partial Disability Rider II
key_features: Waiver of premium on terminal illness or disability
Preferential rates for non-tobacco users
exclusions: Suicide within 12 months of start or revival: higher of 80% of premiums paid or the surrender value
notes: The website says cover goes up to age 99, but the brochure's term table is unclear.
No riders are available on point-of-sale policies.

plans.name: e-Term
plans.tagline: Term plan with Life, Life Plus and Life Secure options and three payout styles
plans.sum_assured_note: No upper limit, subject to underwriting.
riders: Critical Illness Plus Benefit Rider (37 illnesses)
key_features: Lower premiums for non-smokers and women
Waiver of future premium on total permanent disability (Life Secure option)
unconfirmed_fields: entry age, term and sum assured limits (taken from Kotak Bank's page, not the insurer's)
notes: Eligibility figures come from a Kotak Bank distributor page. Kotak Life's own page did not show them in readable text.
Kotak also has newer term plans such as Kotak Protect Advantage.

plans.name: DigiShield Plan
plans.tagline: Comprehensive online term plan offering 10 flexible plan options with increasing and level cover
plans.sum_assured_note: Minimum ₹30 Lakh, no upper ceiling subject to financial underwriting.
key_features: 10 diverse plan options
Accelerated terminal illness payout
Special discounted rates for salaried non-smokers
exclusions: Suicide within 12 months: nominee receives higher of 80% total premiums paid or surrender value
notes: Option to reduce sum assured at retirement age 60.

plans.name: iSelect Smart Term Plan
plans.tagline: Online term plan with spouse cover discount, return of premium option, and milestone increments
plans.sum_assured_note: Starts from ₹25 Lakh, no maximum limit subject to medical tests.
death_benefit_options: Monthly income (0.83% of SA for 100 months)
key_features: Discounted joint life cover for spouse
Return of Premium option available
Life stage protection top-up on marriage and parenthood
exclusions: Suicide within 12 months: 80% of total premiums paid refunded
notes: Backed by Canara Bank and HSBC.

plans.name: Mera Term Plan Plus
plans.tagline: Pure protection plan offering whole life cover up to age 99 with custom child education fund protection
plans.sum_assured_note: No upper limit, subject to board-approved underwriting policy.
death_benefit_options: Lump sum plus increasing monthly income
key_features: Child Education Support booster
Coverage options up to age 99 (Whole Life)
Waiver of premium on disability
exclusions: Suicide within first 12 months from policy inception
notes: Special lower premium bands for salaried professionals.

plans.name: iTerm Prime Insurance Plan
plans.tagline: Paperless 100% digital term plan with high solvency backing and dedicated salaried pricing tiers
plans.sum_assured_note: No limit, online video KYC and swift STP underwriting.
death_benefit_options: Dual payout (50% lump sum + 50% staggered income)
key_features: Highest solvency ratio among Indian life insurers (3.02x)
Digital STP issuance with video KYC
10% discount for women non-smokers
exclusions: Suicide clause standard 12 months from policy date
notes: Formerly Aegon Life Insurance.

plans.name: Click 2 Protect Supreme
plans.tagline: Flagship new-gen term plan offering increasing cover option, instant claim advance, and terminal illness payout
death_benefit_options: Increasing cover up to 10% per annum
Lump sum with child milestone guarantee
riders: Income Benefit on Accidental Disability Rider
key_features: 100% accelerated payout on terminal illness diagnosis
Instant claim advance to family upon notification
Option to increase cover on life stages
exclusions: Suicide within 12 months: 80% premiums or surrender value paid
notes: Advanced tier plan with automated underwriting.

plans.name: Smart Wealth Advantage Term
plans.tagline: Term plan with special Early Exit Value returning 100% of all premiums paid at age 65
plans.sum_assured_note: No upper ceiling subject to underwriting.
death_benefit_options: Return of premium on early exit
riders: Max Life Critical Illness and Disability Rider
key_features: Special early exit benefit: full refund of premiums paid at age 65
Terminal illness cover included automatically
Premium break option during job loss or emergency
notes: Ideal for individuals seeking pure risk cover during earning years and capital refund at retirement.

plans.name: Zindagi Plus
plans.tagline: Innovative term plan featuring the 'Better Half Benefit' covering your spouse with zero medical examination
plans.sum_assured_note: Starts from ₹25 Lakh with no upper ceiling.
death_benefit_options: Lump sum plus monthly income (1% for 36/60 months)
key_features: Better Half Benefit: 50% cover transferred to spouse without medical checks if insured passes away
Waiver of premium on critical illness
Increasing life cover option
notes: Unique dual-spouse security feature.

plans.name: Radiance Smart Term Plan
plans.tagline: Affordable online pure protection plan backed by Bank of Baroda & Union Bank of India
key_features: Backed by leading public sector banks
Terminal illness cover built-in
Attractive discount for non-tobacco users
notes: Public sector banking partnership trust.
